description: Returns the JSON Schema (x402-review/1, draft-07) that content_json must satisfy for a review of a product in the given category, for submit_admin_approved_review, register_purchase_review and update_review_content. Call this before writing a review to discover what fields are required. The response names the category's kind: a review carries schema_version, core and open_review, plus at most one block, keyed by that kind; the schema returned contains only that block. A category with no kind (outside the category vocabulary) is reviewed with core and open_review only. Paid health-check and directory listings cannot be reviewed. No chain_id or authentication needed — schemas are global and static.

category.description: Product category slug (e.g. 'chain.rpc'), as GET /v1/product-categories lists them.

name: get_review_schema
